task: Cover the shopping list (`/`), seeded with Oat milk, Lemons and Rye bread. Adding an item appends it to the list with its position number. Move up and Move down swap an item with its neighbour and the position numbers follow; the first item's Move up and the last item's Move down are disabled. Ticking Bought updates the status line (`3 items · 1 bought`) and shows the Clear bought button, which removes every bought item; the button is absent while nothing is bought. Order and bought state are stored on the server and survive a reload.
